correctness.rationale: The finite claim has exact and exhaustive quantification. C11 enumeration constructs the 24 permutations, all 10,626 distinct four-subsets, and full 24x24 regular convolution matrices. Every square minor has determinant <=2^24 in absolute value by Hadamard, so one rank computation modulo prime 1000000007 is exactly the characteristic-zero rank. Subgroup order is computed by exact closure. Independent Python SymPy rational ranks on 34 translation/inversion orbits cover every support and reproduce counts; explicit irreducible 1+1+2+3+3 block ranks reproduce the same orbit ranks and yield 18 profiles. Actual programs and expected outputs were replayed from their delivered file content. No numerical inference or unexamined case is used.

value.rationale: This is a canonical complete nonabelian Fourier-rank problem on S4, the smallest symmetric group with 1,1,2,3,3 irreducible dimensions. Four unweighted taps produce eight exact ranks, a 34-orbit classification and a genuinely exceptional rank-20 stratum appearing only for full difference subgroup. It quantifies invertible and noninvertible convolution codebooks on the whole natural support family, beyond the universal rank lower bound or determinant-zero condition. Exact finite cases and precise invariants are motivated, not arbitrary slices or routine substitution. Only this finite group, unit coefficients and complex rank are claimed.
